meta.calculation_method: Sep 18 close to Sep 25 close for week-over-week ETF comparison

one_line_week: Mega-cap technology led a positive week while small caps lagged.
highlights: QQQ and MAGS materially outperformed the broad market.
IWM finished the week lower, showing weaker small-cap participation.
Friday ended stronger as oil and yields eased from the week’s extremes.
benchmark_takeaways: Growth leadership was clear: QQQ +3.19% versus SPY +1.27%.
Small caps diverged: IWM -0.75% for the week.
leadership_notes: The strongest configured baskets were technology-heavy.
Headline index gains masked weaker participation in small caps.
breadth_title: Breadth was weaker than the headline indices
breadth_notes: MarketWatch reported 302 of 503 S&P 500 constituents down for the week.
Friday breadth improved, but weekly participation remained narrow.
macro_notes: Bond yields remained near multi-decade highs.
Oil volatility stayed a key inflation and risk-sentiment input.
